title: Bags of grace
description: This mod adds 2 bags: a starter kit and a respawn kit
body:
This mod adds 2 bags
- a starter bag
- a grace bag
After spawning you should get a starter bag.
the starter bag will give you a lootable including starter armor with random enchants 
(leather or chain mail)
 a few tools (sword, pickaxe, axe) with random enchants (wooden or stone)
food (bread or steak) with a random about between a quarter stack or half stack
you could aslo get coal, torchs and a rare chance for a sheild.

this mod was created to have a few extra gear to aid after you die, but I later added the starter kit as there isn't realy any good starter kits out there.

Made with <3 by Mrcode
